name: System Administration & OS‑level Operations
description: Perform system‑level tasks: check ports, manage processes, inspect system info, organize desktop files.
instructions: When performing OS‑level operations, first check permissions. Use `execute_command` with `background: true` for long‑running services. Prefer `check_port` to find available ports before binding. For file organization, use `list_directory` and `move_file` (if available) to structure desktop or workspace files. Always confirm destructive actions (delete, kill) with the user.
examples: To start a server on port 5000, first run check_port 5000, then start with background: true.
constraints: Never kill processes without user confirmation.
Do not modify system files outside the workspace without explicit approval.
